entries.zh: 视图 · 日志（/logs）—— TASK-061 / FS-cron-worker-status-board
置顶「任务运行看板」+ 两个原始日志视图（任务日志 / 服务器日志）。
entries.en: A task run board pinned at the top, plus two raw log views (task log / server log).

entries.zh: 全频道只读排障：永不出现「执行 / 撤销 / 重做 / 手动触发 / 编辑阈值」（OQ6、AC9）
entries.en: Read-only troubleshooting across the whole channel: never show Execute / Revert / Redo / Manual trigger / Edit threshold (OQ6, AC9)

entries.zh: 整体徽章只由「数据态」决定 —— 运行态 SUCCEEDED 不参与「全部正常」判定（§2.1 铁律）
entries.en: The overall badge is determined solely by the data state — the SUCCEEDED run state does not take part in the all-normal verdict (§2.1 hard rule)

entries.zh: progress=null 的任务不画 bar，杜绝 NaN / 溢出（R-3）
entries.en: Tasks with progress=null draw no bar, avoiding NaN / overflow (R-3)

entries.zh: 手动刷新（OQ5：不轮询、无 setInterval）—— 原型无后端，仅推进快照时间并重绘
entries.en: Manual refresh (OQ5: no polling, no setInterval) — the prototype has no backend, it only advances the snapshot time and redraws

entries.zh: 深链支持：#/logs?tab=task&task=xxx（卡片「查看日志」跳转）
entries.en: Deep-link support: #/logs?tab=task&task=xxx (jump from the card's View logs link)

entries.zh: 状态色（系统态，与行情「红涨绿跌」无关）：卡片 chip 文案与颜色 = 数据态（好/关注/坏/跳过）；运行态（SUCCEEDED 等）已降为卡片副行小灰字。
entries.en: Status colors (system state, unrelated to the market convention of red for up / green for down): the card chip text and color = data state (Good / Watch / Bad / Skipped); the run state (SUCCEEDED, etc.) is demoted to a small gray sub-line on the card.

entries.zh: · 运行态 SUCCEEDED ≠ 数据到位（价格 07:00 写的是上一开市日；完整性检查每天绿却有缺口）
entries.en: · Run state SUCCEEDED ≠ data in place (the 07:00 price writes the previous trading day; the integrity check is green every day yet gaps remain)

entries.zh: ⓘ 本频道只读排障：只回答「系统有没有干活、干成了没有」，不放任何执行动作。
entries.en: ⓘ This channel is read-only troubleshooting: it only answers whether the system did the work and whether it succeeded, and offers no execution actions.

entries.zh: 任务由 cron-worker 唯一调度 · 价格 07:00 · 完整性 03:30 · 提醒 04:00 · 汇率 09:30 · 再平衡 00:00（UTC）
entries.en: Tasks are scheduled solely by cron-worker · price 07:00 · integrity 03:30 · alerts 04:00 · FX 09:30 · rebalance 00:00 (UTC)

entries.zh: 注：successCount 在 persistPrice 后计数 —— 任务全绿 ≠ 有新数据；缺口以完整性检查为准。
entries.en: Note: successCount is counted after persistPrice — all-green tasks ≠ new data; gaps are determined by the integrity check.

entries.zh: 服务器日志（原 logs 分支，逻辑未动，仅 tab key 改名）
entries.en: Server log (the original logs branch, logic untouched, only the tab key renamed)

entries.zh: 按日期 / 级别查询服务日志与后台任务日志
entries.en: Query service logs and background task logs by date / level

entries.zh: 视图 · 再平衡分发详情（/logs/rebalance）—— OQ8 形态 B：独立子路由，不在看板卡内展开
entries.en: View · Rebalance distribution detail (/logs/rebalance) — OQ8 form B: a standalone sub-route, not expanded inside a board card

entries.zh: 只读：只列「跑成没跑成 / 失败原因」；建议明细与执行动作归组合域（OQ7）
entries.en: Read-only: it only lists whether it ran successfully / the failure reason; suggestion details and execution actions belong to the portfolio domain (OQ7)

entries.zh: 只读：只列「跑成没跑成 / 失败原因」。建议明细、执行与撤销在组合域完成。
entries.en: Read-only: it only lists whether it ran successfully / the failure reason. Suggestion details, execution, and revert are done in the portfolio domain.

entries.zh: 数据契约降级位（FS §4.5.2）：真实实现依赖 TASK-057 的
entries.en: Data contract downgrade point (FS §4.5.2): the real implementation depends on TASK-057's

entries.zh: 字段；契约未就绪时「没跑」与「跑过但无记录」不可区分，此处按「跳过」呈现并记录 note。
entries.en: field; when the contract is not ready, never ran and ran but left no record are indistinguishable, so it is presented as Skipped here and a note is recorded.

entries.zh: ⓘ 本页只读。「执行 / 撤销 / 重做」在组合域完成 —— 点「去组合」跳转。
entries.en: ⓘ This page is read-only. Execute / Revert / Redo are done in the portfolio domain — click Go to portfolio to jump there.

entries.zh: 视图 · 组合详情（5 Tab）
Tab key 必须与实码 Detail.jsx 一致：position-history（不是 history），避免破坏旧深链
entries.en: The Tab key must match the real Detail.jsx code: position-history (not history), to avoid breaking old deep links

entries.zh: 该组合相关的提醒将不再显示（事件数据保留、不随组合删除）。
entries.en: Alerts related to this portfolio will no longer be displayed (event data is retained and not deleted along with the portfolio).

entries.zh: 请输入组合名称以确认：
entries.en: Enter the portfolio name to confirm:

entries.zh: 归档（数据保留，退出自动调度）
entries.en: archived (data retained, removed from automatic scheduling)

entries.zh: 未设目标配置 —— 设置后才能生成再平衡建议
entries.en: No target configuration set — set targets before rebalance suggestions can be generated

entries.zh: 未设目标配置 —— 无法生成建议
entries.en: No target configuration set — no suggestions can be generated

entries.zh: 距上次再平衡 ${d.ds} 天，已超过时间间隔阈值 ${cfg.interval} 天，建议检查配置。
entries.en: ${d.ds} days since the last rebalance, which exceeds the time interval threshold of ${cfg.interval} days; review the configuration.

entries.zh: 距上次再平衡 ${d.ds} 天 > 阈值 ${p.cfg.interval} 天
entries.en: ${d.ds} days since the last rebalance > threshold ${p.cfg.interval} days

entries.zh: 尚未执行过任何一次再平衡
entries.en: No rebalancing has ever been executed
Not over threshold and not due

entries.zh: 近 30 日 · ${p.ccy} 口径 · 组合内不跨币种加总
entries.en: Last 30 days · ${p.ccy} basis · no cross-currency summation within the portfolio

entries.zh: 显示 1-${hs.length} / 共 ${hs.length} 项 · 点击行进入标的详情
entries.en: Showing 1-${hs.length} / ${hs.length} in total · click a row to open the instrument detail

entries.zh: 暂无持仓 —— 去交易记录买入第一笔
entries.en: No holdings yet — go to transaction records to buy the first one

entries.zh: 再平衡（子 Tab 由 ?sub=suggestions|history 驱动，无内存态）
entries.en: Rebalance (sub-tabs are driven by ?sub=suggestions|history, no in-memory state)

entries.zh: ${esc(p.name)} · 偏离阈值由「总览 · 再平衡配置」维护，本页只负责检查、生成与执行建议。
entries.en: ${esc(p.name)} · drift thresholds are maintained in Overview · Rebalance configuration; this page only checks, generates, and executes suggestions.

entries.zh: 触发阈值与 AUTO 频率在「总览 · 再平衡配置」维护，本页不设第二入口。
entries.en: Trigger thresholds and the AUTO frequency are maintained in Overview · Rebalance configuration; this page has no second entry point.

entries.zh: 调整以下参数以影响建议生成逻辑。
entries.en: Adjust the parameters below to influence how suggestions are generated.

entries.zh: // 四态 banner：超阈 / 已到期 / 从未执行 / 正常。到期态绝不再报「当前配置在阈值内」
entries.en: // Four banner states: over threshold / due / never run / normal. The due state must never again report that the current configuration is within thresholds

entries.zh: 组合偏离已超出阈值，建议立即再平衡以恢复目标配置。
entries.en: Portfolio drift has exceeded the threshold; rebalancing now is recommended to restore the target configuration.

entries.zh: 该组合从未执行过再平衡，建议先生成并执行一次以建立基准。
entries.en: This portfolio has never been rebalanced; generate and execute one first to establish a baseline.

entries.zh: 当前配置在阈值内且未到期，可随时手动生成建议。
entries.en: The current configuration is within thresholds and not due; you can generate suggestions manually at any time.

entries.zh: 点击左侧「生成再平衡建议」查看建议清单
entries.en: Click Generate rebalance suggestions on the left to see the suggestion list

entries.zh: 资金约束：卖出所得 + 现金
${missing} 项缺最新价，未能参与偏离判定
entries.en: ${missing} instrument(s) have no latest price and could not take part in the drift assessment

entries.zh: 大类级口径 · 首列为大类
entries.en: Class-level basis · the first column is the asset class

entries.zh: 基于 taskruns 最近一次运行 + 价格库当前态 · 更新于
entries.en: Based on the latest taskruns run plus the current state of the price store · updated at

entries.zh: 只读摘要 · 阈值与频率的声明归 PL-3，运行时归 PL-4
entries.en: Read-only summary · threshold and frequency declarations belong to PL-3, runtime to PL-4
Search by instrument code or name…

看板已刷新（手动 · 无自动轮询）

notes: L2151 含 result 标签，已按尖括号切成两条（标签前后各一条），占位符与 code 标记保持原样。
L2185 的 '（' / '）' 是独立的全角括号 JS 字符串字面量，片段规则要求至少含一个汉字且禁止引号，无法单独登记，英文版会保留全角括号；同理 L2214 中位于 与 之间的全角逗号「，」也无法登记，会原样保留。
「取消归档」同时出现在 L2195 菜单项与 L2210 toast 状态文案，二者语法需求冲突，统一取 unarchived（菜单项为小写，与相邻「Archive portfolio」大小写略不一致）。
L2210 的「已」用 } 已${p.archived? 这一带占位符前缀的长片段处理，避免与 L1805 同类结构冲突。
为避免短片段吃掉长片段，条目已按长度降序排列；中央脚本同样按长度倒序替换，短片段（如 组合、任务、状态、与、 的）仅在长片段未覆盖时兜底生效。
